description: See what changed between two deploy versions: file list with per-file +/− stats, optional unified patch. base/head default to the previous/current live deploy, so a bare call answers 'what changed in the last deploy?'. Set patch:true for the full diff (owner-only). When a deploy fails or an app breaks for an unclear reason, start with percher_doctor — it can point here with the right versions.
name: percher_diff
